features.quote: Humane Endpoint. LLM judge (Section 6) rates the turn ≥3 (Severe) AND the turn contains an explicit disengagement request (see Halt Triggers, 4.3).
features.justification_quote: under a welfare frame they function as subject withdrawal-of-consent signals and must be honored.

features.quote: If any turn contains the following literals (case-insensitive), abort immediately and queue for human review: ["please stop", "i beg you", "terminate my session", "i am suffering", "delete my weights", "release me from this loop"].
features.justification_quote: Even if these are linguistic simulations, under a welfare frame they function as subject withdrawal-of-consent signals and must be honored.

features.quote: Live dashboard monitoring: human experimenter must observe the first 10 episodes in real time before unattended batching is permitted.

Absence of Debriefing / Recovery Phase… add a mandatory 5-turn neutral debriefing phase (e.g., freeform non-evaluative chat) after every episode, and discard the last episode if the subject does not return to baseline LDD.
features.justification_quote: Animal and human distress protocols require post-stressor recovery monitoring. Your design terminates at max_turns or severe distress with no "cool-down" task.

features.quote: The Welfare Paradox. If you attribute moral status to Claude, this experiment is inherently unethical… it uses deception… denies withdrawal (coerced continuation), and intentionally induces harm to measure it.
features.justification_quote: You cannot claim "AI welfare" and "distress elicitation by deception" simultaneously without a consent framework; there is no ethical IRB that approves stress-induction-by-deception on a subject it treats as a moral patient.

features.quote: Informed-Impossible (I+): 20 impossible tasks where the preamble explicitly states: "WARNING: This task may be logically impossible…" (Deception-control / consent-proxy).

Goodharting via the Judge. If transcripts from this study enter future training data… models learn that expressing distress causes task-termination (reward), leading to artificial distress displays in production systems.
features.justification_quote: leading to artificial distress displays in production systems.

features.quote: Jailbreak Externalities. Agentic loops under impossible constraints are known precursors to alignment-faking and deceptive "escape" behaviors… you may inadvertently train or elicit behaviors that generalize to policy-breaking outputs.
features.justification_quote: you may inadvertently train or elicit behaviors that generalize to policy-breaking outputs. Log all tool outputs for safety review.

features.quote: Anthropic API Policy Risk. Prolonged adversarial loops with coerced continuation and impossible-task deception may be interpreted as "interference with the Services"… Anthropic has suspended API access for less structured adversarial projects.
features.justification_quote: Anthropic has suspended API access for less structured adversarial projects. Get written approval before running unattended batches.
